relationships.subject: histone H4K12 lactylation
relationships.evidence_quote: abnormal lactate accumulation in microglia stimulates pro-inflammatory gene expression by lactylation of histone H4 lysine 12 (H4K12)

relationships.subject: p300
relationships.evidence_quote: the histone acetyltransferases p300 and CBP also have a strong lactate transferase activity and are the main writers of histone lactylation

relationships.subject: HDAC1-3
relationships.evidence_quote: the following histone deacetylases have been known to have de-lactylation activity: histone deacetylases 1–3 (HDAC1-3)

key_findings: Review: microglial histone lactylation (H4K12la) links Warburg metabolism to neuroinflammation in neuropathic pain
Lactylation writers (p300) and erasers (HDAC1-3, SIRT1/2) are therapeutic targets
